<function name="OnChange" parent="DCheckBox" type="panelhook">
	<description>Called when the "checked" state is changed. This is for Overriding</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<file line="51-L55">lua/vgui/dcheckbox.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="bVal" type="boolean">Whether the CheckBox is checked or not.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Creates a metamethod on the DCheckBox class to print any changes to the console.</description>
	<code>
function DCheckBox:OnChange(bVal)
	if (bVal) then
		print("Checked!")
	else
		print("Unchecked!")
	end
end
	</code>
	<output>All new checkboxes created will print `Checked!` or `Unchecked!` when their checked state is changed.</output>

</example>
